transcript: Speaker A: Why are you not answering your phone? I've been standing at your location with your courier for the last 30 minutes. Please come immediately and collect it. I can't keep waiting any longer. Speaker B: Aati hoon, aati hoon. [Coming, coming.] Arey bhaiya, aapka gussa dekh kar toh main darr hi gayi thi. Aur haan, woh bhi itni fluent English mein? Kaise bol lete ho itni acchi English? [Oh brother, I got scared seeing your anger. And that too in such fluent English? How do you speak such good English?] Speaker A: Mam, jab se English mein bolna seekha hai na, tab se mujhe jab bhi customer pe gussa aata hai, toh main uspar English mein hi chilla deta hoon. Customer bhi sochne lagta hai ki koi bahut bada officer aaya hai delivery karne. Haan haan, aapko toh pata hi hai ki aaj kal English bolne waalo ki hi izzat hai. [Mam, since I learned to speak in English, whenever I get angry at a customer, I yell at them in English. The customer also starts thinking that some big officer has come to deliver. Yes yes, you know that nowadays only those who speak English get respect.] Speaker B: Lekin yeh batao, tumne itni acchi English bolna seekhi kahaan se? English Seekho App? Main kuch samjhi nahi. [But tell me, where did you learn to speak such good English? English Seekho App? I didn't understand.] Speaker A: English Seekho App spoken English ka best app hai. Jahaan experts ekdum basic level se English samajhna aur bolna sikhate hain. Aur iske AI coach ka toh kehna hi kya! 24*7 available rehta hai, English mein baat karne ki practice karane ke liye. Maine toh English Seekho App ke AI coach aur expert ke madad se hi English bolna seekha hai. Baaki yeh lijiye aapka courier, mujhe bahut late ho raha hai. [English Seekho App is the best app for spoken English. Where experts teach understanding and speaking English from the very basic level. And what to say about its AI coach! It is available 24/7 to practice speaking in English. I learned to speak English with the help of English Seekho App's AI coach and expert. Anyway, here is your courier, I am getting very late.] Ab aap log mujhe kya dekh rahe hain? Jao English Seekho App download karo aur English bolna seekh jao. [Now what are you guys looking at me for? Go download English Seekho App and learn to speak English.] Speaker C: Toh install button pe click karo aur English Seekho App download karo. [So click on the install button and download English Seekho App.]
on_screen_text: English Seekho, INSTALL NOW, [Disclaimer text in Hindi regarding non-affiliation and results variation]
summary: A delivery boy surprises a customer by venting his frustration in fluent English. He explains that speaking English earns him respect and attributes his skills to the English Seekho App's expert lessons and 24/7 AI coach. The ad concludes with a call to download the app.
